detail.longDescription: Creating Apps in SailfishOS using Golang: Daemons and stuff In this article we'll learn how to create parts of the code for SailfishOS apps in Golang. Namely we'll use an approach where the GUI is written in standard Qt and communicates with the daemon using D-Bus or a socket. https:// chrastecky.dev/programming/cre ating-apps-in-sailfish-os-using-golang-daemons-and-stuff
